meta.name: pr-to-video
meta.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把代码改动变成讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常需要向团队讲解代码改动
copy.tagline_en: Turn code changes into an explainer video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain code changes to others

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能把一个 GitHub PR 变成讲解视频：读取代码改动、提交和文件，生成故事板和旁白脚本，渲染成 mp4。适合做更新日志、功能展示、修复说明或重构讲解。
howto.when: 当你提供 GitHub PR（链接、owner/repo#N，或已检出仓库中的“这个 PR”）并要求把它做成视频时触发。

say.text: 给 owner/repo#456 做一段功能展示的讲解视频
say.note: Claude 会按功能展示类型生成故事板和脚本。

say.text: 把当前仓库里的“这个 PR”做成修复说明视频，用男声
say.note: Claude 会使用男声生成旁白并渲染视频。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude turns a GitHub PR into a code-change explainer video: reads the diff, commits, and files, builds a storyboard and script, and renders an mp4. For changelogs, feature reveals, fixes, or refactors.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you give Claude a GitHub PR (URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) and ask for a video about that change.

say_en.text: Turn this PR into a video: https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/123
say_en.note: Claude will fetch the PR's diff and start planning.

say_en.text: Make a feature-reveal explainer video for owner/repo#456.
say_en.note: Claude will build a storyboard and script for that type.

say_en.text: Make a fix-explainer video for 'this PR' in this repo, using a male voice.
say_en.note: Claude will pick a male voice and render the fix video.
